# Bridge actions

*generated by release/export.py; do not edit*

The 175 IPC verbs a release build of the bridge dispatches, grouped as in `bridge/src/action_registry.inc`. These are not MCP tools: a model reaches the bridge only through the tools in [tools.md](tools.md). 6 more exist only in a debug build; see the last section.

## AI control

`toggle_all_ai`, `enable_all_ai`, `send_interaction`

## Intent Queue (AI evaluation hook)

`queue_intent`, `query_intents`, `query_intent_results`, `query_dispatch_result`, `cancel_intent`, `clear_intents`, `send_decision`, `set_lifestyle_focus`, `set_education_focus`, `set_council_task`, `construction_check`, `add_construction`, `construct_building`, `declare_war`, `declare_war_debug`, `pre_validate_war`, `set_offgoal_veto`

## Console Command Passthrough

`execute_scripted_effect`, `execute_engine_effect`, `break_alliance`, `set_break_alliance_enabled`, `set_vacant_fill_enabled`, `set_force_offensive_stance`, `force_offensive_stance`, `call_war_create_core`, `do_call_war_create_core`, `raise_armies`, `raise_raiders`, `raid`, `create_title`, `execute_script_block`

## Pause / Speed

`pause_game`, `unpause_game`, `set_speed`
